REMOTE

Garvers in-house Federal Team is looking for a Proposal Coordinator with strong written communication skills to support Department of Defense project pursuits. This role calls for a background in creative writing and design along with high-level critical thinking skills to compile, proofread, and edit a continuous flow of documents.

This position will develop and coordinate SF330 proposals for federal government design business opportunities, including organizing large amounts of information, providing creative layouts, and editing technical sections. The ideal candidate will have a strong sense of detail and experience preparing SF330 proposals, as well as the ability to work independently on assignments, multi-task, and prioritize duties to meet deadlines.
Although Garvers Federal Team is based in North Little Rock, AR, this individual can work remotely (preferably in our 22-state footprint) or from one of our 60+ office locations.
Core Responsibilities

column2: Manage the proposal process from RFP release to client delivery. This includes owning the document and communicating proposal needs to the team; maintaining internal draft deadlines; crafting and editing complex SF330 proposals; as well as performing quality control checks to ensure RFP requirements are met.
Coordinate and organize large amounts of technical information, including photography, external subconsultant data, and marketing materials.
Conceptualize and collaborate with the graphics team to create visually appealing marketing material.
Work with technical staff to develop consistent content to carry over from statements of qualifications, proposals, and interview presentations.
Serve as a collaborative member of the Federal Team to maintain the central information database of custom-created content for use on future proposals.
Participate in and represent Garver at annual national military conferences as needed.
Assist the Federal Team in developing dynamic client presentations to win the job!

column1: Required Qualifications

column2: Bachelors degree in communications, journalism, marketing or a related field.
4+ years of marketing experience in the Architecture/Engineering/Construction (A/E/C) industry.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Previous experience in Standard Form 330 (SF330) proposal development.
Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills.
Strong proficiency in Adobe InDesign and Microsoft Office Suite.

column2: Individual high-deductible healthcare plan paid for by Garver, including HSA contributions.

Opportunity to work on unique projects that keep military bases running smoothly, including training ranges, readiness centers, and entry control points.

Are you a proven leader in bridge inspection with a passion for delivering safe, reliable infrastructure? Garver is seeking a National Bridge Inspection Practice Leader to lead and grow our bridge inspection practice. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership, offering the opportunity to lead and build a dynamic team, manage key client relationships, and oversee a portfolio of profitable inspection projects.

As the Bridge Inspection Practice Leader, you will set the operational and strategic direction for our inspection practice, ensuring excellence in project delivery while driving business development and team growth. Youll have the autonomy to run a business within a business, supported by Garvers resources and collaborative culture.
Responsibilities

column2: Develop and execute a strategic plan for bridge inspection services.
Recruit, mentor, and manage a high-performing inspection team.
Foster collaboration across design, inspection, and specialized service teams.
Build and maintain strong client relationships with DOTs and municipalities.
Lead proposal development, interviews, and presentations.
Identify and pursue new opportunities for inspection and related services.
Oversee and manage bridge inspection projects to SNBI and state-specific standards.
Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards.
Coordinate field operations, including scheduling and resource allocation.
Serve as a technical advisor for inspections, load ratings, and rehabilitation projects.
Provide guidance on inspection methodologies, reporting, and data management.
Support integration of advanced tools and technologies in inspection workflows.

column1: Experience Requirements

column2: Bachelors degree in civil engineering from an ABET-accredited program.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Completion of NHI Course No. 130055 (Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges). And refresher course 130053
10+ years of experience in bridge inspection, with at least 5 years in a leadership or project management role. Qualify as a Bridge Inspection program Manager
Strong knowledge of SNBI standards, AASHTO guidelines, and DOT processes.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to develop and manage teams.
Experience preparing scopes, budgets, and schedules for inspection projects.

column1: Preferred Skills and Experience

column2: NHI Courses: 130078 (Bridge Inspection Techniques for Nonredundant Steel Tension Members (NSTM)), 130091 (Underwater Bridge Inspection).
Experience with InspectX, AssetWise, AASHTOWare Bridge Management (BrM), and MicroStation.
Familiarity with asset management software and 3D modeling tools.
Previous experience leading inspection programs for DOTs or large municipalities.
Perform load ratings and rehabilitation design using modern engineering tools and best practices.

Are you an experienced Process Engineer interested extending your career by ensuring the quality of water and wastewater design with the best firm to work for in our industry?
Weve got an opportunity for you on our Water Business Line (WBL) QC Team.

As part of Garvers WBL QC Team, you will be performing quality control reviews on designs for water and wastewater treatment facilities and other ancillary infrastructure associated with water and wastewater projects. Youll be reviewing process modeling, hydraulic modeling, design calculations, facility and equipment layouts, coordination with equipment vendors and coordination with regulatory agencies, and coordination with support disciplines and regional offices. You may travel occasionally, if desired, to coordinate with the design team.

column2: Water and wastewater treatment processes
Process modeling and develop criteria using analysis of water and wastewater process modeling data
Water and wastewater process evaluation, selection, and implementation
Hydraulic analysis of water and wastewater treatment plants
Chemical storage and feed systems
Blower systems and blower sizing
Process flow diagrams
Piping and instrumentation diagrams
Specification and contract documents

Masters degree in civil, environmental, chemical, or related engineering discipline
20 or more years of direct experience designing water and wastewater treatment facilities
Professional Engineer Licensure (PE)
Experience with biological modeling software such as BioWin, GPS-X, and Sumo
Experience working with a diverse disciplinary team, including civil, structural, building mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation and control (or I&C) disciplines

column2: Experience using Bluebeam software
Experience with hydraulic modeling software such as Visual Hydraulics

Practice Leader - Water Reuse

At Garver, we are committed to delivering innovative, sustainable solutions that strengthen the communities we serve. We are seeking a Water Reuse Practice Leader to guide the growth of our water reuse practice, working closely with clients, regulators, and internal teams to deliver advanced treatment and reuse projects.

Travel as needed to support client meetings, business development, and project delivery.
